documented_probe: C-759c32c0 (enable password-based authentication): reference floor is easy and this covering task exercises it at easy — generate a PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hash of the configured secret in the exact documented format, wire it into the gateway auth config, and the verifier confirms a fresh service accepts the secret and rejects everything else.
notes: HTTP-services covering task for C-759c32c0 (vine-helix is the reference, where the same capability appears inside a much larger sysadmin bundle). Easy: a single hash-generation + config-wiring script plus a captured hash file, with idempotency and per-config iteration counts as the only mild traps. Hidden cases use different iterations/enabled flags/ports and check wrong-secret rejection.
